skill.name: opencontext
skill.description: Persistent memory and context management for AI agents using OpenContext. Use it to load background, search prior conclusions, and store project decisions.
skill.summary: Use OpenContext to preserve AI agent context across sessions, repositories, and multi-agent workflows.
skill.author: supercent-io

security_audit.summary: Most external command findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks in documentation. Real risks remain around persistent hidden home-directory storage, user-level AI tool configuration, API key handling, and optional embedding-provider network use.

remediation.issue: Persistent context can store sensitive data outside the workspace.
remediation.suggestion: Add clear guidance to exclude secrets, regulated data, and customer information from OpenContext notes and indexes.

remediation.issue: Initialization may change user-level commands, skills, MCP files, and AGENTS.md.
remediation.suggestion: Require users to review every generated file path before running oc init or accepting configuration changes.

remediation.issue: Embedding setup may expose context text and credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend secure key storage, avoid pasting real keys into shell history, and document when data leaves the local machine.

static_findings.snippet: | `/opencontext-help` | When you don't know where to start |
| `--mode keyword` | Keyword-based search | No embeddings required |
| `--mode vector` | Vector search | Embeddings + index required |
| Cite document | Click the citation icon next to the document title | Agent reads the full document

semantic_findings.title: Persistent Context Store Outside Workspace
semantic_findings.description: The skill directs agents to store project background, decisions, pitfalls, and next steps in hidden home-directory OpenContext storage. Sensitive project information may persist beyond the current repository and session.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The default storage paths and daily workflow explicitly describe persistent context storage and recording conclusions. The privacy risk depends on what users save, but the persistence behavior is clear.

semantic_findings.title: External Package Installation And User-Level Configuration
semantic_findings.description: The setup flow tells users to install or run an npm package, then initialize OpenContext. The documented init step can generate user-level commands, skills, MCP configuration, and update AGENTS.md.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The install and init commands are explicit, and the file lists the user-level locations affected. This is legitimate setup, but it has supply-chain and persistent configuration impact.

semantic_findings.title: Embedding Provider May Receive Context Data
semantic_findings.description: The semantic search setup asks users to configure an embedding API key, base URL, model, and build an index. Context documents may be sent to the configured embedding provider.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The configuration lines clearly enable embedding-backed search and indexing. The exact data sent depends on OpenContext behavior and selected documents, so confidence is high but not absolute.

content.value_statement: AI assistants lose project context across sessions and tools. This skill provides OpenContext workflows for loading background, searching documents, and storing conclusions.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to initialize OpenContext in a project with the oc CLI.
Provides slash command workflows for loading, searching, creating, and iterating on context.
Documents folder, document, manifest, search, and stable link commands.
Shows how to configure keyword, vector, and hybrid search modes.
Describes MCP tools for listing folders, searching documents, creating documents, and generating links.
Gives daily and multi-agent workflows for sharing project knowledge across AI tools.
limitations: Requires the OpenContext CLI, desktop app, or MCP integration to be installed separately.
Vector and hybrid search require an embedding key and an index build.
Stored context may contain sensitive project information and should be managed carefully.
The skill documents workflows but does not include the OpenContext application code.

use_cases.title: Resume Work Across Sessions
use_cases.description: Load project background, decisions, and known pitfalls before starting a new assistant session.
use_cases.target_user: Developers using Claude, Codex, or Claude Code

use_cases.title: Share Knowledge Across Agents
use_cases.description: Use OpenContext search and manifests to coordinate research, implementation, and testing between multiple AI tools.

use_cases.title: Record Project Decisions
use_cases.description: Store acceptance criteria, API contracts, dependency notes, and lessons learned after each work session.

prompt_templates.title: Load Project Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new work session
prompt_templates.prompt: Use OpenContext to load the most relevant background for this repository before we start work.

prompt_templates.title: Search Past Decisions
prompt_templates.scenario: Find prior conclusions before making changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Search OpenContext for prior decisions, pitfalls, and API contracts related to this feature.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Decision Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an OpenContext note that captures the decision, rationale, affected files, and follow-up work from this session.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Multi-Agent Work
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow across analysis, coding, and testing agents
prompt_templates.prompt: Use OpenContext to prepare a manifest, search related documents, and store final conclusions for a multi-agent implementation task.

output_examples.input: Load context for a payment API change.
output_examples.output: A short list of relevant documents, prior decisions, known pitfalls, and files to read before coding.

output_examples.input: Store conclusions after fixing a build issue.
output_examples.output: A concise project note with the root cause, validated fix, commands run, and next recommended checks.
A work plan that assigns context search, code analysis, implementation, testing, and final knowledge capture.

best_practices: Load OpenContext background before making project decisions.
Store only useful conclusions, citations, pitfalls, and next steps.
Review context documents for secrets before enabling embedding-based search.
anti_patterns: Do not store credentials, customer data, or private keys in context notes.
Do not run initialization commands without reviewing user-level configuration changes.
Do not rely on stale context when source files or requirements have changed.

faq.question: What does this skill help me do?
faq.answer: It helps AI assistants load, search, and save project context with OpenContext workflows.

faq.question: Does it install OpenContext for me?
faq.answer: No. It documents installation and usage commands for the OpenContext CLI, desktop app, and MCP tools.

faq.question: Can it work without embeddings?
faq.answer: Yes. Keyword search works without embeddings. Vector and hybrid search require embedding configuration.

faq.question: Where is context stored?
faq.answer: The documented default store is under the user home directory in OpenContext folders and a local database.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The skill lists workflows for Claude, Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, and MCP-enabled agents.

faq.question: What should I avoid storing?
faq.answer: Avoid secrets, production credentials, regulated data, and private customer information.
